summary: Governance is directionally coherent and structurally stable. No governance-product artifact changes occurred since the March 16 nightly report. All three canonical top priorities remain correctly ordered and supported by the full product stack. Health remains yellow for the same structural reason as prior cycles: the two main execution gaps — assembly consumability/packaging decision and machine-checkable coverage of assembly integrity — remain open. Two new cross-product signals emerged from March 16 activity that are relevant to Governance: (1) broken links inside governance assembly artifacts were identified in the Control Tower overnight synthesis and deferred as a sub-30-min fix; and (2) the Weekly Jobs Review created OPS-2026-069 for retiring the JOB-GOV-001 proof-case bundle. Both are low-urgency items but each adds minor pressure on Priority 1 (product-as-product discipline) and Priority 2 (assembly consumability). The governance assembly packaging decision remains the strongest current blocker and continues to await Peter's triage.

topPriorities.title: Operate Governance as a real product with explicit outcomes and reviewable progress
topPriorities.whyThisMattersNow: Governance must model the same explicit goal/evidence/priority discipline it imposes on the rest of the portfolio. Credibility depends on this self-discipline being visible and reviewable.
topPriorities.currentStatus: Holding. Governance product stack is active, well-structured, and being exercised through recurring nightly reporting. No drift detected against plan/metrics/decisions. The JOB-GOV-001 retirement signal (OPS-2026-069) is a minor nudge: retiring done proof-case bundles cleanly is part of the same discipline.
topPriorities.nextConcreteStep: Continue explicit priorities, metrics, and review-output discipline. Confirm next formal product review on track for ~2026-04-11 per monthly cadence (MODEL.yaml last_reviewed: 2026-03-11). Track OPS-2026-069 (JOB-GOV-001 retirement) through to completion.

topPriorities.title: Complete Governance assembly v0.1 into a clearly consumable and verifiable pack
topPriorities.whyThisMattersNow: Governance only delivers transferable downstream value when the assembly can be installed, verified, reviewed, and maintained without hidden assumptions. Assembly is still 'candidate' status. A packaging decision intake signal was raised overnight 2026-03-15 and is awaiting triage. Additionally, the Control Tower identified broken links inside assembly artifacts on 2026-03-16 — a concrete repair that can be executed without a decision but should not be deferred indefinitely.
topPriorities.currentStatus: Blocked on packaging/consumability decision. Assembly artifact structure exists (assembly.yaml, ACTIVATION.md, VERIFY.md, policy/ops artifacts), but the explicit packaging decision and verification-semantics alignment remain open. Governance intake signal 'intake:governance:2026-03-15:assembly-packaging-decision' is pending TDE triage. Broken assembly artifact links are an identified sub-task, deferred since 2026-03-16, fixable within ~30 minutes.
topPriorities.nextConcreteStep: 1. Fix broken links in governance assembly artifacts (sub-30-min, executable now). 2. Triage 'intake:governance:2026-03-15:assembly-packaging-decision' in TDE. 3. Make the packaging model explicit. 4. Align VERIFY.md to the chosen model. 5. Promote assembly status from candidate when packaging is confirmed.

topPriorities.title: Extend machine-checkable governance toward the assembly surface and source-of-truth integrity
topPriorities.whyThisMattersNow: Governance's main leverage is machine-enforced validation. The next control-quality gain is reducing drift between product state, assembly state, and what the repo actually ships.
topPriorities.currentStatus: Active but not yet staged. Repo-level validation is a known strength; assembly integrity/completeness is not yet part of that control surface per RISKS.md#R-003 and PLAN.md objectives 3-4. Correctly sequenced after Priority 2 packaging decision.
topPriorities.nextConcreteStep: Define and stage the next validator increment for assembly integrity/completeness. Ensure product/assembly/source-of-truth linkages are explicit in governance artifacts. Do not initiate before Priority 2 packaging decision is settled.
